description.en: Xiaomi MiMo Coding Plan / Token Plan provider for DeepSeek Harness: browser OAuth sign-in with the MiMo Code encrypted-callback protocol or quick tp-/ttp-/sk- key paste, live model discovery with per-model adaptive reasoning levels, Token Plan credits pill plus the mimo_quota tool, MiMo ASR as a cloud voice-input recognizer and MiMo TTS for read-aloud, encrypted-at-rest credentials, Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 把 Xiaomi MiMo Coding Plan / Token Plan 接入 DeepSeek Harness：浏览器 OAuth 授权登录（MiMo Code 加密回调协议）或快捷粘贴 tp-/ttp-/sk- 密钥；模型自动发现、按模型自适应推理档位；套餐余量药丸与 mimo_quota 工具；MiMo ASR 云端语音输入、MiMo TTS 朗读；凭据加密落盘，Web 与 Desktop 双端。
